rule: a profile switch forgets every card (ProfileSession's call)
mutation: drop InstallCards.shared.forgetAll() from a successful switch
note: ProfileSession needs the live core, so no unit test reaches the call. Without it the outcome holds two other ways: the core answers a request from before a switch with code switched, which CoreClient turns into a cancellation that clears the card (aCancelledRequestLeavesNothing checks the store side), and every switch rebuilds the screens, so Find addons opens again and forgets finished results. The call stays as the explicit reset the plan asks for.
